name: @nopilot/schema-diff-engine
description: Deterministic JSON Schema engine: path-level diff between two schema versions, breaking vs non-breaking change classification (required additions, type narrowing, enum removals, minimum tightening, pattern changes, required-property deletion...), same-document $ref tracking, draft-07 & 2020-12 keyword subsets with explicit not_supported reporting, and instance validation. Pure local computation, zero network, zero LLM.
author: latbert
